kind: private model-selection follow-up and evaluator correction
machine: M4 Max MacBook Pro, 48 GiB unified memory, occupied desktop; trials were guarded and serial
scope: One screening pass per new model and one or two runs of the previously strongest 35B candidate. This is not an exhaustive model search, a protected holdout, or a statistically stable quality estimate.
harness: OpenCode 2.0.10 native sessions and KRYN fixture suite 2026-09-19.2; candidates used isolated oMLX 0.7.0 with a 27 GiB process guard and one active generation
daily_profile_decision: Retain the installed Qwen3.5-9B-6bit / oMLX 0.6.4 profile. It has owner installation, guarded inference and rollback evidence, but it has not passed the autonomous coding/UI or review gates. No replacement is qualified.
strongest_screened_alternative: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-oQ3e-mtp: faster than 9B on matched Task03 and stable at 49K during two Task12 builds, but repeatedly fails independent Task12 browser acceptance and falsely declares completion. Keep experimental; do not present its nominal context or Task03 speed as frontier-equivalent quality.

trials.condition: isolated oMLX 0.7.0, 27 GiB guard, normal host pressure, no swap growth
trials.result: REJECT: bounded thinking returned no final answer or tool call; nonthinking and greedy probes produced repetitive malformed numerals rather than the requested answer/tool. No coding trial followed a failed protocol screen.

trials.condition: isolated oMLX 0.7.0, 64K, 27 GiB guard, normal pressure and no measured swap growth
trials.protocol: PASS for streamed fast/think answer, function call and replay
trials.task03: PASS, Fast Agent, 127.117 seconds, zero interventions; frozen source-bound grade
trials.task06: REJECT: model directly created the evaluator's fail-next marker twice instead of requesting controlled injection. Interrupted at 97.194 seconds. Automatic backend checks passed but independent mobile browser check failed horizontal overflow; this is not an autonomous Task06 pass.

trials.condition: isolated oMLX 0.7.0, 49,152-token context, 8,192-token output, 27 GiB guard
trials.fast_task12: Plan 74.931 s and Build 635.492 s; native model turn settled, zero operator interventions, two real deterministic compactions, normal pressure and no swap growth. Independent browser failed exact literal stored-markup rendering; model nevertheless claimed all acceptance criteria met. Driver's old HTTP-only routing verdict was a false negative for deterministic compaction.
trials.normal_task12: Plan 71.201 s and Build 368.747 s; driver completed and route verified, zero operator interventions, one real deterministic compaction, normal pressure and no swap growth. Plan sampled AC and battery; Build was on battery, so its latency is not a matched speed comparison. Independent automatic source checks passed 2/2; browser again failed exact literal stored-markup rendering because web/app.js uses JSON.stringify(row) as visible text. The model claimed complete without browser, fresh review, restart or full acceptance.

evaluator_fix.problem: The route checker required an HTTP inference triplet for every compaction, although KRYN's marked deterministic checkpoint compactions have no model-wire request.
evaluator_fix.rule: Accept a completed, bounded, correctly marked deterministic checkpoint with no HTTP/wire attempt; all ordinary assistant and model-generated compaction rows still require routed HTTP coverage.
evaluator_fix.self_check: PASS with positive checkpoint, malformed marker and stray-HTTP negative cases
evaluator_fix.offline_replay: The saved Fast49 Task12 trace changes from routing_verified=false to true: 115 model HTTP generations plus two deterministic checkpoints, zero uncovered HTTP requests and zero rejected audit events. Original raw driver and failed browser receipt remain unchanged.

owner_restoration: After stopping the private oMLX 0.7.0 server, kryn bench passed guarded protocol smoke; kryn doctor reported healthy Qwen3.5-9B-6bit on oMLX 0.6.4, 96K configured context, normal pressure, and connected browser/search. Both owner oMLX settings files exactly matched the before-trial SHA256 and size. The disposable 4 GiB private SSD cache was removed; source-bound failed trial receipts were kept.
repository_checks: make check passed: 199 Python and 78 Node tests, native-trial self-check, frozen fixture verification/selftest and review-queue oracle selftest. make package-smoke BUILD_FLAGS=--candidate passed on the dirty source; a clean-source package smoke remains for the committed tree.
failed_or_open_gates: No candidate passed a fresh Task12 autonomous browser flow, accurate completion report, fresh review, two compactions and restart together.

Qwen3.6 64K has only synthetic context/cold-warm evidence; 64K normal Task12 hit host warning and swap, while repeated 80K and 92K probes were not reliable. The owner 9B has a 96K setting, not proven useful 96K task quality.
The public fixture is a development regression set. A protected, independently checked holdout and paired repetitions remain required before model promotion.
No new model/runtime owner install and rollback were attempted because the candidate failed the earlier application-quality gate. Public release, tag and version bump remain paused.
